reference_baseline_advective_challenge_v.defaultRecommendationTemplate: Keep the corrected reference mass-balance family as the default screening baseline for this scenario.
reference_baseline_advective_challenge_v.challengeRecommendationTemplate: Keep the corrected reference family as the primary baseline and run the experimental advective family as a governed challenge path because the scenario exposes residence-time-sensitive or duration-sensitive screening cues.
reference_baseline_advective_challenge_v.reviewNeededTemplate: Do not recommend a model-family path for assessor-facing reuse until baseline fit and applicability issues are resolved.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the selection recommendation preserves the governed baseline-versus-experimental framing and does not promote the advective family to default status.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Selection review should preserve the released reference family as the suite baseline and keep the advective family explicitly non-default.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Review whether the primary baseline family remains a good fit and whether any challenge family fit/applicability lines justify extra assessor attention.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Selection review is only meaningful when the baseline family is still appropriate and any challenge family is being introduced for governed reasons.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Confirm the recommendation records the duration or residence-time trigger signals and, when applicable, the governed comparison profile that should be used next.
reviewChecklist.rationale: Assessors need to see why a challenge path was recommended and what governed comparison path should follow.

reference_baseline_advective_challenge_v.reviewPacketTemplate: Build a governed assessor-facing review packet for the model-family selection recommendation, preserving baseline-versus-experimental framing, trigger signals, fit/applicability context, and comparison-path guidance.
reference_baseline_advective_challenge_v.reviewBriefTemplate: Summarize whether the governed model-family selection recommendation is ready for assessor-facing reuse, highlighting trigger signals, applicability, and experimental-family caution where relevant.
reviewNotes: Treat the advective family as experimental and non-default even when it is recommended as a challenge path.
Use the governed comparison profile to compare reference and advective outputs before carrying the candidate family into assessor-facing review.
Do not skip the reference baseline when a challenge family is recommended.
reference_baseline_advective_challenge_v.applicabilityNote: Use this selection profile when the corrected reference family remains the suite baseline and the advective family is only a governed experimental challenge path.
